name: Sacrificial Siphon
summary: Cha save or the touched creature is cursed (-1d4 on attacks and checks) and each time it takes damage you can use a Reaction to gain 10 Temporary Hit Points; on a success you gain 5 Temporary Hit Points instead.
text: You touch another creature and lay a draining curse on it. It makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure it is cursed for the duration: it subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and ability checks, and whenever it takes damage you can take a Reaction to gain 10 Temporary Hit Points. On a success you gain 5 Temporary Hit Points and the target subtracts 1d4 from its ability checks until the start of your next turn. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
